name: ECA Entity Share
description: Integrate ECA with the Entity Share module and its plugins.
project_description: ECA Entity Share bridges the ECA (Events-Conditions-Actions) rules engine to the Entity Share content-syndication module. It ships two hidden submodules that each register one Entity Share Symfony event as an ECA event plugin, so site builders can react to those points of the Entity Share sync lifecycle from an ECA model without writing PHP. The client submodule exposes the 'Relationship Field Value' event fired while a client imports remote entities; the server submodule exposes the 'Channel list prepared' event fired while a server assembles its list of shareable channels. The top-level module is a hidden package holder and provides no code of its own.
